title: New Year SMP (2025)
description: A New Year plugin for SMP servers featuring dynamic health system and epic "Judgment Night" mode. Every death reduces your maximum HP, which can only be restored through PvP battles or defeating the Wither. Includes full localization in 5 languages, grief
body:
Transform your server into an intense survival experience!

Features:
• Dynamic Health - Lose HP on death, gain HP on kills
• Judgment Night - Battle royale events with spectator mode
• Nether Roof Protection - Damage above Y=127
• Explosion Control - Blocks TNT/Creepers, allows Wither damage
• 5 Languages - Russian, English, German, Spanish, French

Commands: /smp reload, /smp king start/stop, /smp nether on/off/damage

Requirements: Paper/Spigot 1.21+ | Java 21+

Perfect for hardcore SMP and PvP servers!
